_note: REVISION B of the asset registry (operator directive t220u, 2026-10-19). This is the current registry for the ceremony, verifier registration, token address index, price runs and deploy pages. Rows copied unchanged from deployment/assetRegistry.resolved.json (prior revision). See deployment/ASSET_REGISTRY_REVISION_B.md and deployment/ASSET_REGISTRY_REVISIONS.md.

rules.token: survives only if at least one single DEX pool of the row's own contract on its own chain has >= $10,000 liquidity AND that pool traded in the last 24 hours; pools reporting more than 2x market cap dropped; price fresh (updated in the last 24 hours) from CoinGecko, DexScreener or GeckoTerminal; liquidity summed across pools does not count; no substitute price; fail closed
rules.native: survives on a fresh CoinGecko price (updated in the last 24 hours); no wrapped pool required (operator decision t219u)
